note: squeal: the wheel's spin-up loss by physics, its sound share and spectrum from recorded landings; thump: one recorded touchdown, at the edge of detection, written at its estimate; where it would pass full scale through a soft knee, driven in at thump_drive of its growth past thump_knee_db over (held_db, limited_db, distortion: the clipper's share of its energy). Each wheel's files are one waveform under different envelopes, cross-faded by amplitude, the energy neighbours' differences cost put back (coherence: their correlation, cell by cell). exposure_dba: each file's own, at its node; law_dba: what it plays at there (exposure = K + 20 log10 of the slip or sink)
